purpose: Manage notification delivery channels, inspect recorded delivery outcomes, and manage browser push devices.
primaryGoal: Configure, enable, test, edit and remove real delivery destinations without losing source trust or provider capabilities.

identity.mode: READ-ONLY source audit; report and heartbeat writes only

dataSources.name: Configured channels
dataSources.behavior: Shared query key, request AbortSignal and safeArray normalization; page retains successful data on refresh failure.

dataSources.name: Delivery statistics
dataSources.behavior: INTERVALS.STANDARD polling, AbortSignal, independent trust state; no reported date bounds.

dataSources.name: Channel actions
dataSources.behavior: Mutations and invalidation/broadcast remain hook-owned. Webhook test is separately implemented in useNotificationChannels.ts:100-115. No action was invoked.

dataSources.name: Webhook signature preview
dataSources.behavior: 300ms debounced server computation from entered secret and explicit sample test body. Sample is a signature-preview utility, not fake live delivery data.

dataSources.name: Browser push
dataSources.behavior: 404 key response means server-disabled; independent key/list queries and local currentEndpoint state. Actual browser registration and permission remain unverified.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing title, subtitle, primaryAction, secondaryActions, query, dataSources, copyLink, children; independent source notices without page-wide error replacement.

components.name: OperationalBrief / useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: Four numeric count metrics; countTotal for enabled/total; source scope, timestamp and provenance retained. No competing stats renderer needed.

components.name: DataState / StaleRefreshWarning
components.contract: fatalError only replaces missing source; refreshError/offline preserve retained data and individual retry.

components.name: UI controls
components.contract: Button, Toggle, Badge, Heading, Text, SectionTitle, Input, Select, HelpIcon, Modal, ConfirmDialog and CopyButton; shared owners not edited.

components.name: Channel presentation
components.contract: ChannelStatsBand, ChannelsGrid, ChannelCard, ChannelProvidersPanel, ChannelFormModal, WebhookSignaturePreview and channelMeta preserve seven provider types and typed payload mapping.

components.name: BrowserPushChannelCard
components.contract: Per-device capability/key/permission states; enable/disable, device list, removal, current-device identity and iOS instructions.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Existing entrance wrapper; actual reduced-motion behavior unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Card emits success/error toasts also supplied by generic toggle/delete/test mutation hooks; generic test hook success is unconditional even when success=false, whereas card checks the result.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Choose one existing feedback owner and preserve result-sensitive failure reporting; do not add another toast pipeline.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Grid auto-fit min(min(100%,18rem),1fr); provider reference 1/2/3 columns; device/provider band stacks until xl; modal picker 2/3/4 columns.

issues.rule: MDC-043 / preserve small-width and long-label reachability
issues.detail: Edit footer places Test connection, flexible spacer, Cancel and Update in one non-wrapping flex row. No wrapLabel is supplied. Long translations or narrow modal content can exceed allocated width; overflow not exercised.
issues.fix: Reflow footer with responsive wrapping/stacking and existing Button.wrapLabel while retaining all three actions.

responsive.viewportMatrix: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560 all unverified; RTL, 200% text and long labels unverified.

sourceStrengths: Named page sections and channel list
Shared modal and discard guard reused

issues.detail: Provider tiles are Buttons with role=radio and aria-checked, but no native radio inputs, arrow-key handling or roving tabIndex. All seven tiles enter tab order independently.
issues.fix: Reuse existing RadioCard with shared name, checked/value and onChange, preserving provider selection/config reset; confirm native keyboard behavior and focus in modal.

issues.rule: MDC-012 / disabled is not low-contrast interactive content
issues.detail: Whole disabled-channel card uses opacity-60 although its edit/test/delete/toggle controls remain interactive; effective contrast is reduced for all text and controls.
issues.fix: Keep disabled meaning in semantic Badge/Toggle rather than reducing the entire card's opacity; measure composed contrast.

accessibility.limits: Keyboard/focus trap/restoration, screen reader, target spacing, composed contrast, forced colors and motion have not been exercised.

states.sourceStrengths: Page preserves three main sections independently. ChannelsGrid has skeleton, retry error and actionable empty state; browser push has unsupported, key retry, checking, busy and action-failure states. Retained queries use StaleRefreshWarning.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-033 unknown is not zero
issues.detail: Missing stats/fields become numeric 0, including enabled/total 0/0, before the shared metric formatter. A no-stats state can publish zero metrics even while status says No statistics supplied; paused initial queries and null/malformed responses are not authoritative zeros.
issues.fix: Pass null/undefined numeric measurements and missing reasons through existing shared metric contract; only show zero when supplied by the source. Keep all four metrics and recorded unbounded scope.

issues.detail: Absent channels normalize to [] and are passed to ChannelProvidersPanel without source state. During initial loading/failure, provider counts become 0 in use and Not configured; the real list's error does not make these derived counts known.
issues.fix: Keep provider catalog visible but pass channels source trust into the panel, suppressing derived counts or marking them unknown/loading/error while preserving retained counts and retry.

issues.detail: isSubscribed defaults false before async getSubscription resolves; lookup failures are swallowed. Card can show Not subscribed and Enable without establishing current-device state.
issues.fix: Extend the existing hook with explicit checking/error state and retry, then consume it in the existing card; do not create a second device-state source.

issues.detail: Registered-devices list and its heading disappear on a resolved empty result; there is no affirmative empty-state explanation.
issues.fix: Keep registered-devices section with localized empty explanation after successful empty response, separate from loading/failure/retained states.

issues.detail: unsubscribe catches server and browser unsubscribe failures, clears local state and returns true. Card's boolean action failure surface cannot distinguish incomplete removal.
issues.fix: Preserve intended best-effort browser disable but return an explicit partial/failure outcome and reconcile actual subscription state; keep server-first behavior and recovery.

visualIssues.detail: Provider selected tiles use neon-cyan border/background and result panel uses neon-green/red tints. Provider colors are fixed hex metadata, and cards/provider rows retain fixed-white chrome. These compete with saved-theme neutral tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border/text tokens with restrained semantic selected/result state; retain provider identity and all saved theme/chart choices without changing persistence.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports useToast directly from @/components/feedback/Toast instead of the existing feedback category barrel.
Toggle does not receive disabled=toggleMut.isPending; repeated clicks can queue concurrent inversion requests while displayed checked state is unchanged.
architectureIssues.fix: Disable existing Toggle during its mutation and preserve independently scoped feedback/recovery.

architectureIssues.detail: Save invalidates channels only; delete/toggle also invalidate stats. Create or editing enabled state leaves configured enabled/total KPI stale until periodic polling.
architectureIssues.fix: Existing save hook owner should invalidate/broadcast existing stats key alongside channels without changing polling/retry/key semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: Preview masking checks token/key/password substrings but not webhook_url. Catalog help explicitly calls provider webhook URLs credentials; ChannelCard renders unmasked webhook_url previews.
architectureIssues.fix: Make existing preview helper respect explicit credential metadata, preserving fields and edit functionality without exposing credential-bearing destinations in card text.

priority.first: Correct unknown-to-zero/provider counts and browser device trust, then native radio keyboard behavior and mutation lifecycle.
priority.next: Subdue theme-independent chrome and make edit footer resilient without removing actions.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing useWebPush lifecycle trust extension
requiredSharedChanges.props: Retain permission, isSupported, isPushSupported, isSubscribed, currentEndpoint, subscribe and unsubscribe; add subscription lookup status/error/retry and explicit incomplete unsubscribe outcome.
requiredSharedChanges.states: Do not map failed lookup to not subscribed or failed unsubscribe to unconditional success.
dependsOn: Existing card action error and retained-query surfaces

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing channel mutation feedback/cache integration
requiredSharedChanges.props: Keep hook input/output and query keys; make test success result-aware, establish one feedback owner and invalidate stats after save.
requiredSharedChanges.states: Preserve channel-scoped pending/error behavior and cross-tab broadcast.

competingImplementations.name: Manual button-based provider radiogroup versus native RadioCard
competingImplementations.resolution: Reuse existing RadioCard; no new picker library/shared owner required.

competingImplementations.name: Feature/provider fixed color chrome versus canonical saved-theme tokens
competingImplementations.resolution: Reuse tokens and semantic Badge/controls; no new palette engine.

sections.name: Delivery channels
sections.behavior: All configured channels and per-channel actions; loading/error/retry/empty add action

actions: Page refresh of channels and stats
dataBehavior: Preserve retained data and independent neighbors on refresh failure
Preserve query keys, AbortSignals, polling and invalidation/broadcast
Preserve provider-specific fields and payload mapping/defaults
Preserve per-device endpoint identity, registration state, iOS explanation and browser permission boundary
Do not invoke tests/subscription/mutations during audit
preservation.si: Counts and channel configuration are not physical unit conversions. Preserve raw existing webhook-test latency_ms API field; do not infer a backend SI migration or add display conversion engines.
preservation.workspace: Source getWorkspaceRouteScope resolves /notifications/channels to range=false, vehicle=false: path absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and /notifications is disabled prefix. No duplicate selector exists or is needed; preserve unbounded stats explanation.
preservation.sourceInventoryNote: Computed hashes and line counts below are read-snapshot identities, not runtime acceptance. Large shared files were inspected only at reported ranges.

evidenceLimits.backendBehavior: Only route declarations and frontend callers inspected; no handlers/database behavior, actual auth, delivery, HTTP response, server time bounds or emitted signatures verified.
evidenceLimits.tests: Not run: assignment forbids full gates; source-only audit. No borrowed historical receipts.
evidenceLimits.violationsScript: Read audit.sh but intentionally did not execute because it unconditionally runs project-wide npx tsc --noEmit. Scoped source-pattern counts recorded separately.
evidenceLimits.restrictions: No Git, source/shared/queue edits, runtime mutations, messages, production requests or questions. Only assigned JSON and heartbeat written.
evidenceLimits.concurrency: Snapshot may drift under other workers; root hash rechecked at release. No whole-feature preservation percentage claimed.

commands.command: Get-FileHash scoped files -Algorithm SHA256; Get-Content scoped files; scoped regex counts; ConvertFrom-Json report schema verification
commands.note: Dynamic provider styles counted but not classified as prohibited static CSS-variable styles; full TypeScript/script intentionally NOTRUN.
